address: 8 Lane 92, Section 1, Jianguo North Road, Zhongshan District, Taipei, Taiwan
bio: With a rich background in French cuisine, the chef weaves Western cooking techniques with Asian ingredients, crafting dishes that are simple in appearance yet meticulous in detail. The menu changes every three months and reflects the seasons well. In winter, for instance, the lamb main course is marinated with spices such as cardamom and cinnamon, imparting unforgettable, rich flavours. For lunch on weekdays, a shorter set menu is available with optional add-ons. The room is modern with an open kitchen, so diners can watch the cooking unfold.
